title: RequiredResourceAccess
description: Specifies the set of OAuth 2.0 permission scopes and app roles that an application requires access to.

resourceAppId.description: The unique identifier for the resource that the application requires access to (e.g., Microsoft Graph).

id.description: Identifier of the permission scope or app role.

type.description: Whether this is a delegated permission (Scope) or application permission (Role).
